# PPR Pond Mapper

In this project, I use remote sensing, machine learning, and open science practices to map terrestrial wetlands in the Great Plains region at a high level of detail. This work is funded by the USFWS and NASA, in an effort to better inform waterfowl conservation. Learn more about it [here](https://www.landscapemodeling.net/water.html). 

![Example of model performance: estimated surface water (blue) compared to observed surface water delineations (white).](media/ppr_model.png)

::::

```{=html}
<script>
(function() {
  var labels = ["April 1-15","April 16-30","May 1-15","May 16-31","June 1-15","June 16-30","July 1-15","July 16-31","August 1-15","August 16-31","September 1-15","September 16-30","October 1-15","October 16-31"];
  var frameCount = labels.length;
  var img = document.getElementById('plot30-frame');
  var slider = document.getElementById('plot30-slider');
  var label = document.getElementById('plot30-label');
  var playBtn = document.getElementById('plot30-play');
  var playing = false;
  var timer = null;

  function frameSrc(i) {
    var n = i + 1;
    var padded = n < 10 ? '0' + n : '' + n;
    return 'media/plot30_panels/panel_' + padded + '.png';
  }

  function showFrame(i) {
    img.src = frameSrc(i);
    label.textContent = labels[i];
    slider.value = i;
  }

  function stepFrame() {
    var next = (parseInt(slider.value, 10) + 1) % frameCount;
    showFrame(next);
  }

  function stopPlaying() {
    playing = false;
    playBtn.innerHTML = '&#9654;';
    playBtn.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Play');
    if (timer) { clearInterval(timer); timer = null; }
  }

  function startPlaying() {
    playing = true;
    playBtn.innerHTML = '&#10074;&#10074;';
    playBtn.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Pause');
    timer = setInterval(stepFrame, 700);
  }

  slider.addEventListener('input', function() {
    stopPlaying();
    showFrame(parseInt(slider.value, 10));
  });

  playBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
    if (playing) { stopPlaying(); } else { startPlaying(); }
  });

  for (var i = 0; i < frameCount; i++) {
    var preload = new Image();
    preload.src = frameSrc(i);
  }

  showFrame(0);
})();
</script>
```
